en.summary: Choose your sampling effort and share finished videos.
changes: Five sampling effort levels, with time estimates from matching local generations.
Optional preset files download only when needed. Higher-step generation accounts for their GPU memory.
Save a sharing image or a separate sharing video with timing, GPU and memory details. Your original video stays unchanged.
Includes the latest Apple silicon Mac preview and bilingual release notes.

zh.summary: 选择采样档位，分享生成作品。
changes: 新增五档采样滑块，根据本机相近记录预估耗时。
按需下载档位缓存，并为高步数增加的显存占用留出空间。
可保存包含耗时、显卡和内存信息的分享图或分享视频，原视频保持不变。
包含最新 Apple 芯片 Mac 预览版及中英文更新说明。
